scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c bgBlue.white,bgGreen.white "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm install --prefix backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
